bill_text.text_with_changes:
A House concurrent resolution relating to the regent nomination joint committee.

BE IT RESOLVED, by the House of Representatives of the State of Minnesota, the Senate concurring:
Pursuant to Minnesota Statutes, section 137.0246, subdivision 2, the joint legislative committee for regent nomination shall meet at 6:00 p.m. on March 18, 2025.
